result.instructions: Tools for Api2Pdf, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Api2Pdf data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run api2pdf_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run api2pdf_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run api2pdf_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. api2pdf_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: api2pdf_html_to_pdf
tools.title: HTML to PDF (Chrome)
tools.description: Render an HTML string to a PDF using the headless-Chrome engine. Returns a { FileUrl } link (valid ~24h) by default. Great for invoices, reports, and letters produced as HTML. BILLED per document. Api2Pdf API: POST /chrome/pdf/html.

html.description: The HTML source to render into a PDF.

inline.description: If true (Api2Pdf default), the generated file is served inline; if false, as an attachment.

fileName.description: A name for the generated file, e.g. 'invoice.pdf'.

options.description: Engine-specific render options (page size, margins, orientation, headers/footers, etc.). Passed through verbatim to Api2Pdf.

useCustomStorage.description: If true, Api2Pdf uploads the result to your own storage (see `storage`) instead of hosting it.

storage.description: Custom storage target, used when useCustomStorage is true.

method.description: HTTP method Api2Pdf uses to upload (e.g. 'PUT').

url.description: Pre-signed destination URL for the upload.

extraHTTPHeaders.description: Extra HTTP headers Api2Pdf forwards when it fetches a source URL (e.g. auth for a protected page/file).

output_binary.description: If true, return the raw file bytes as base64 instead of a FileUrl. Default false (recommended for agents — returns a short-lived link).

tools.name: api2pdf_generate_barcode
tools.title: Generate barcode / QR code (Zebra)
tools.description: Generate a barcode or QR code image. `format` is the symbology (e.g. 'QRCode', 'Code128', 'PDF417', 'DataMatrix') and `value` is the string to encode. Returns a { FileUrl } (valid ~24h) by default, or base64 with output_binary:true. BILLED. Api2Pdf API: GET /zebra.

value.description: The string to encode in the barcode/QR code.

showlabel.description: If true, render the encoded value as a human-readable label under the barcode.

output_binary.description: If true, return the raw image bytes as base64 instead of a FileUrl. Default false.
